metadata.title: AI Chatbots And Customer Loyalty: A Systematic Literature Review
metadata.description: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has transformed customer service delivery across industries, with AI-powered chatbots emerging as pivotal tools for enhancing customer interactions and fostering loyalty. This systematic literature review synthesizes empirical evidence from peer-reviewed studies published between 2019 and 2026 to examine the relationship between AI chatbot service quality and customer loyalty. Following PRISMA guidelines, this review analyzes 62 articles sourced from Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore databases. The findings reveal that chatbot service quality dimensions—including response time, information quality, perceived usefulness, personalization, and anthropomorphic characteristics—significantly influence customer loyalty through the mediating mechanisms of customer satisfaction and trust. The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and SERVQUAL emerge as the predominant theoretical frameworks underpinning this research domain. This review contributes to the academic discourse by providing an integrative conceptual framework, identifying research gaps, and offering strategic implications for organizations seeking to leverage AI chatbots for customer retention in the digital economy.
keywords: AI chatbots, customer loyalty, service quality, customer satisfaction, systematic literature review, technology acceptance.

metadata.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence In English Language Teaching: Opportunities, Challenges, And Future Directions
metadata.description: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) has emerged as a transformative technology with the potential to redefine English Language Teaching (ELT) by enhancing instructional practices, learner engagement, and educational accessibility. Unlike conventional educational technologies, Generative AI can create original content, provide personalized learning experiences, generate instant feedback, and support teachers in curriculum planning, assessment, and instructional design. This review paper critically examines the applications, opportunities, and challenges associated with the integration of Generative AI in ELT. It synthesizes recent scholarly literature to explore how AI-powered tools facilitate the development of the four language skills—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—as well as grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and formative assessment. The paper further discusses the role of AI in reducing teachers' administrative workload while promoting differentiated and learner-centred instruction. At the same time, it highlights significant ethical and pedagogical concerns, including academic integrity, AI hallucinations, algorithmic bias, data privacy, copyright infringement, digital inequality, and the potential deskilling of educators. The review argues that the effective integration of Generative AI requires responsible institutional policies, continuous professional development, and AI literacy among both teachers and learners. Rather than replacing educators, Generative AI should function as a collaborative pedagogical partner that complements human expertise, creativity, critical thinking, and ethical decision-making. The paper concludes that the future of ELT lies in a balanced human–AI partnership where technology enhances, rather than substitutes, the educational process.
keywords: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI), English Language Teaching (ELT), Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIEd), Human–AI Collaboration, AI Ethics, Technology-Enhanced Language Learning (TELL).

metadata.title: The network that learned to run itself
metadata.description: The limitations of traditional automation with scale and complexity have given rise to a powerful new concept - hyper-automation - Mostly for IT and cybersecurity areas. It is a system that allows machines to be self-managed and self-adaptive through AI, machine learning, and software orchestration, reducing human intervention. Streaming services, IoT sensors, and remote works are just some of the main drivers that bring about the need to shift traditional rule-based automation to proactive, self-regulating networks, which are enabled by real-time monitoring and decision-making like, for example, congestion prevention and resource allocation done autonomously by AIOps tools. So, 24x7 security, with minimum downtime and human error, is possible to achieve by organizations. Meanwhile, the reliance on autonomous systems creates important questions about trust responsibility accountability and Because of this, the necessity of effective oversight as well as the presence of highly trained personnel who are capable of handling these technologies will become paramount to the equation. Businesses that implement hyper-automation [1] well may end up far ahead of the competitors that still rely on manual processes. It just goes to show that as the network landscape evolves, the organizations that are going to thrive are the ones adopting hyper-automation at a deep level. In the end, getting on board with hyper-automation is not only a futuristic consideration, it is a requirement for organizations who desire to be competitive in the digital world.[14][15][16][17]

metadata.title: Cutting Tool Wear Minimization in Machining Operations: A Review
metadata.description: Cutting tool wear significantly influences machining performance, surface quality, and manufacturing cost. Proper minimization of cutting tool wear will result in enhanced life of the cutting tool, surface integrity, precision, and sustainability of the machining process. There are various methods for minimizing cutting tool wear in machining operations. These include the optimization of parameters such as reducing the feed and speed, use of proper coating such as TiN and Al2O3, lubrication/cooling, and proper material for the cutting tool like carbide and ceramic materials. The application of chip breakers and high machine rigidity can minimize wear by lowering heat and friction, which are the major causes of wear. Reduction in wear will ensure a better surface finish, enhanced tool life, and economic efficiency of the machining process. The main objective of this research paper is to conduct an extensive study on wear of cutting tools in machining operations. As a result, the study discusses several advanced methods of tool wear detection in cutting tools, including sensor-based methods, machine vision, and AI/ML-assisted predictive maintenance. Additionally, a critical assessment in tool wear minimization is conducted to apply new material to the cutting tool, the coating process, cutting parameter and path optimization, cooling and lubrication systems such as minimum amount lubrication and cryogenic cooling. Moreover, various challenges with intelligent and autonomous manufacturing systems that arise in tool wear prediction with regard to availability of data and reliability of prediction models are discussed in the study. Finally, potential future research directions are provided, with an emphasis on the importance of using digital twin technologies and sustainable manufacturing approaches in tool wear management.

metadata.title: FUNDAMENTAL FOUNDATIONS OF HIGHER MATHEMATICS
metadata.description:
Mathematics provides the conceptual language through which patterns, structures, quantities, and relationships can be described with precision. It is fundamental not only to the mathematical sciences but also to engineering, computer science, economics, physics, and many other fields that rely on logical analysis and quantitative reasoning. A sound understanding of higher mathematics therefore requires more than familiarity with formulas. It requires the ability to interpret definitions, recognize mathematical structures, justify procedures, and communicate conclusions accurately. Fundamental Foundations of Higher Mathematics: Volume I has been prepared as a bachelor’s degree textbook for students beginning their systematic study of university-level mathematics. Its principal purpose is to establish a coherent foundation in linear algebra, vector algebra, analytic geometry, and the introductory concepts of mathematical analysis. The material is organized to support the gradual transition from computational methods to abstract mathematical reasoning. The volume begins with matrices and determinants, which provide an efficient framework for representing linear relationships and transformations. Matrix operations, determinant properties, inverse matrices, rank, and related structural concepts are developed together with their computational applications. The study of systems of linear equations extends these ideas by examining consistency, uniqueness, elimination methods, and
the interpretation of solutions through matrix structure. The treatment of vector algebra connects algebraic operations with geometric meaning. Vectors are introduced as mathematical objects representing magnitude and direction, followed by linear combinations, scalar and vector products, projections, and geometric applications. These concepts form the basis for the subsequent study of analytic geometry.
The chapters on analytic geometry examine geometric objects through coordinate, vector, and algebraic methods. Lines and curves in the plane are studied before the discussion is extended to points, lines, and planes in threedimensional space. Particular attention is given to the relationship between equations and the geometric objects they represent. The study of quadric surfaces further develops this relationship by analyzing second-degree surfaces, their standard forms, classifications, coordinate transformations, and geometric properties. The later part of the volume introduces the language and foundational ideas required for mathematical analysis. Sets, real numbers, intervals, bounds, supremum, infimum, and related concepts are presented as essential tools for rigorous reasoning. Functions are then examined through their domains, ranges, graphs, classifications, transformations, and qualitative properties. The final chapter develops sequences, limits, and continuity, thereby establishing the conceptual basis for the subsequent study of differential and integral calculus. Throughout the textbook, computational techniques are presented together with their mathematical meaning. Definitions are stated carefully, formulas
are accompanied by explanations of their notation and conditions, and procedures are developed in a logical sequence. Worked examples illustrate the application of general principles, while tables and diagrams clarify relationships that may be difficult to interpret from symbolic expressions alone. Chapter learning outcomes, summaries, and review exercises are included to support systematic study and self-assessment. A central principle of this textbook is that mathematical operations should not be performed mechanically or without attention to their assumptions. Students are encouraged to verify dimensions, domains, sign conditions, geometric interpretations, and theorem hypotheses before applying a formula. They are also expected to distinguish exact mathematical conclusions from numerical approximations and to present solutions in a clear, reproducible form. The textbook is suitable for classroom instruction, guided independent study, and review. Instructors may follow the chapters in their presented order or select topics according to the requirements of a particular academic program. The progression of the material is designed to help students develop both procedural competence and conceptual understanding. Exercises of varying
levels of difficulty may be used for classroom discussion, individual practice, homework, or examination preparation. 
Students are encouraged to read mathematical definitions actively, reproduce derivations independently, verify worked examples, and explain results in complete mathematical sentences. Progress in higher mathematics depends not only on obtaining correct answers but also on understanding why a method is valid, when it may be applied, and how its result should be interpreted. The authors hope that this volume will provide students with a reliable foundation for further study in calculus, linear algebra, differential equations, mathematical analysis, probability, numerical methods, and related disciplines. It is also hoped that the textbook will promote precision, logical discipline, intellectual independence, and an appreciation of the unity
between algebraic, geometric, and analytical methods. We express our appreciation to the educators, researchers, and authors whose work has contributed to the development and teaching of these subjects. We also acknowledge the students and colleagues whose questions and observations have helped emphasize the importance of clarity, consistency, and careful mathematical exposition. Despite every effort to ensure accuracy, constructive comments and recommendations concerning the content, organization, and presentation of the textbook will be welcomed and considered in future editions.

metadata.title: The Influence of Folk Art on Contemporary Artistic and Design Practices
metadata.description:
Abstract: This study aims to examine the influence of folk art and crafts on modern design practices. It will focus on how designers can find innovative ways to apply folk art aesthetic, design languages to evolve and integrate new design languages. The second aspect is how designers can take advantage of technology to achieve desired effects without disturbing the traditional values of the folk arts and crafts. Folk art is deeply rooted in the cultural essence of a region, profoundly influenced by its soil, nature, and geographical characteristics. The close connection between people and their environment is evident in their artistic expressions, where bold and straightforward forms reflect their intrinsic bond with nature. This connection is further exemplified in their vibrant use of colors, linear depictions, and decorative motifs that breathe life into their homes, attire, and everyday objects. The graphic qualities of folk art—its simplicity, charm, and directness—remain fascinating and captivating.
India boasts a rich and diverse tradition of folk art and craft. Each region’s artistic expressions mirror the country’s cultural diversity, shaped by the distinct geographical features of its provinces. Folk art and craft are inseparable from the daily lives of the people, intricately linked to their festivals, rituals, and seasonal changes, which are often tied to agricultural and religious practices. These art forms embody the rhythm of life, weaving together nature and human activity.
For artists and designers, this vibrant lifestyle and its associated art forms—such as dance, music, textiles, pottery, cane work, and geometric crafts—offer a wealth of inspiration. These folk traditions present unique opportunities for exploring functionality, aesthetics, and decoration. The simplification of forms and motifs, particularly of animals, birds, and flora, often serves as a creative foundation for modern interpretations.
This study delves into the inspirational impact of folk art on contemporary artists and illustrators, many of whom have formal training in modern or academic art. Despite their backgrounds, these creators often integrate elements of tribal and folk art into their work, blending these influences with their unique design sensibilities to produce innovative artistic expressions. By analyzing these works, this study uncovers how folk-art traditions resonate within modern creative practices and explores the artistic parameters that define this interaction.
In addition to artistic creations, designers and illustrators have found innovative ways to apply folk aesthetics in communication design. The influence of folk art is evident in advertising, publication design, environmental graphics, outdoor publicity, and editorial illustrations. These contemporary applications demonstrate the enduring relevance of folk aesthetics, as they resonate strongly with the cultural psyche, creating a sense of “Indian-ness” that connects with people across social strata and popular culture. The impact of folk art extends beyond individual creations, influencing the broader field of design education. By studying how artists and designers adapt folk aesthetics, we can identify key inspirational elements that inform modern teaching methodologies.
Practical Implications: Practical exercises based on these findings can be integrated into contemporary design education, fostering a deeper appreciation of folk traditions while equipping students with innovative tools for creative expression. The approach of this study encourages the continuation of folk art’s legacy, ensuring its relevance in modern artistic and design practices. The study not only highlights the cultural significance of these traditions but also offers a roadmap for their integration into the evolving landscape of art and design.

metadata.title: PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE OF PRODUCTION EQUIPMENT USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE METHODS
metadata.description: The work provides a comprehensive analysis of modern approaches to predictive maintenance of production equipment using artificial intelligence methods. It examines the features of reactive, preventive, and predictive maintenance strategies, as well as the principles for building predictive maintenance systems. Modern machine learning methods are analyzed, including Random Forest, LSTM, GRU, Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, and autoencoders, highlighting their advantages, limitations, and suitability for tasks such as classifying equipment condition, predicting remaining equipment life, and detecting anomalies. The typical architecture of predictive maintenance systems has been summarized, and a comparative analysis of modern industrial predictive maintenance platforms has been carried out. Based on a review of the literature, an original qualitative comparison of machine learning methods and a generalized scheme of how predictive maintenance systems function have been developed. It was found that the effectiveness of such systems depends on a combination of quality data preparation, the choice of machine learning algorithms, and architectural decisions. The results obtained can be used as a methodological basis for designing intelligent predictive maintenance systems for production equipment in various industrial sectors.

metadata.title: DIGITAL SCHOLARSHIP AND EMERGING RESEARCH METHODS: THE ROLE OF LIBRARY & COLLABORATION
metadata.description: This presentation examines the growing importance of digital scholarship and emerging research methods in advancing academic research and innovation. It explores the evolving role of libraries in supporting digital research practices, research data management, open science, digital tools, and scholarly communication. The presentation also highlights the value of collaboration among librarians, researchers, institutions, and technology partners in fostering interdisciplinary research, enhancing research visibility, and promoting knowledge creation in the digital age.
